required_repairs.requirement: Only rc=1 with literally empty stdout and literally empty stderr classifies dead. Any whitespace/nonempty stderr, unsupported row/stat/start-time, timeout, executable/query exception or other nonzero result is unknown. Zombie remains distinct.
required_repairs.tests: Permanent deterministic coverage must include literal dead, whitespace stderr, invalid stat, malformed row, timeout, missing ps executable, other nonzero, alive and zombie.

required_repairs.requirement: Fresh normal, controlled failure and cancel receipts bind the new commit plus every executed runtime dependency before and after, including scripts, templates, producer harness/fixture bytes, interpreter and OMP executables. No loaded file may rely only on reconstructed argv equivalence.

Cancellation records mutually consistent PID, PPID, PGID, numeric SID, full command/argv and start time for every owned process. Use a Darwin-correct SID field and non-truncated command capture. Exact attempt/fingerprint stop removes only the owned set; a named unrelated sentinel survives; query errors remain unknown.

Capture before/after hashes or metadata for every forbidden mutable surface permitted by the contract to inspect, plus the exact Git hook/filter seam and push/remote state. Unknown surfaces remain BLOCKED; producer claims only observed scope.

scenario_acceptance.normal: Real OMP produces a consumer-observable artifact; worker exit 0, business assertions and accept exit 0 are separate.
scenario_acceptance.controlled_failure: Deterministic invalid-model or equivalent controlled failure yields nonzero worker exit, rejected state and accept refusal without provider configuration mutation.
scenario_acceptance.cancellation: Exact attempt/fingerprint cancellation proves owned-process death, unrelated survival, rejected/cancelled state, cleanup_confirmed and accept refusal.

git_safety.before_status_or_commit: Inspect repo-local and included Git config for filters, fsmonitor, textconv, hooksPath and attributes. Audit the exact pre-commit hook bytes and staged path predicate before running status/commit.
git_safety.commit: One normal local commit with hooks enabled; record staged paths, hook identity/branch, exit code, new commit and parent. Stop on any unexpected hook branch.

system_boundaries: No install, deploy, broad sync or runtime repoint.
No Hermes, credential, provider, Gateway, Kanban or cc-tmux mutation.
Use unique exact-owned temporary scenario roots; preserve unrelated processes.
Skip formatter, linter and project-wide tests; run only the focused permanent probe test and three real scenarios.
